violations.title: Hot Water and Chemical Sanitizing, Immersion Time
violations.observation: Food-contact surfaces of the Disposable plastic tongs and plastic container are not immersed in hot water at 171F or above for at least 30 seconds. Therefore surfaces are not effectively sanitized. Observed plastic tongs and plastic clear container being washed and rinsed without a sanitizing step before being returned to service
violations.corrective_action: After being cleaned, the food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in manual hot water operations by immersion for at least 30seconds at a water temperature of at least 171F. CFm discarded disposable tongs and container

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. CFM will attain liquid chlorine
